name: Vyond
tagline: Vyond is an AI-powered animated video creation platform that lets teams produce professional cartoon and character-based explainer videos without animation expertise. Its library of characters, scenes, and actions covers business, education, and healthcare scenarios, and an AI script-to-video feature generates a complete animated video from a script. Corporate L&D teams and marketing departments use Vyond to make training and communication content more engaging.
